budget.accounting: reserve actual UTF-8 request bytes plus envelope before send; never refund; stop before exceeding cap

observation.provider: visible text callback from native SSE decoder; no wire body or hidden reasoning stored
observation.waiter: production RequestHandler GET /api/jobs/<id>/progress with actual session guard
observation.browser: optional real browser DOM observer; absent receipts means not observed, never inferred
observation.json_fallback: one complete JSON response is recorded as nonincremental failure
observation.rewrite: record draft/final identities; no forced extra model request
